# King's College Hospital Dubai

> King's College Hospital London - Dubai is a JCI-accredited British multi-specialty hospital in Dubai Hills, off Al Khail Road, currently operating around 100 inpatient beds. A major expansion under way will roughly double bed capacity to about 200 and add operating theatres, together with dedicated centres for oncology, complex liver disease, critical care and precision medicine. The hospital remains fully open to patients throughout the works, which are due to complete in 2028.

## Project Overview

- Category: Advanced Technical Facilities
- Location: Dubai Hills, UAE
- Status: On-Going
- Year: 2028

## MENASCO Scope

King's College Hospital London – Dubai is expanding its multi-specialty hospital in Dubai Hills through a multi-year programme that adds capacity for oncology, complex liver disease, critical care and precision medicine, together with additional operating theatres. The hospital remains fully operational throughout construction. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on the expansion.
